Good straight.
Jul 2026 • Friends
It's a great place that I'd bravely recommend to anyone who comes to Nha Trang. The atmosphere, the music, the beach and the cocktails are all high. Yes, if you live close by, be prepared: in the evening, the music can be very loud and sometimes keeps you awake. But if you're here to relax, it's more of a plus.
Girls should definitely try Coconut Colada, one of the best cocktails I've had in Vietnam. For men, Negroni. Here it is made with real alcohol, not in a "light" version, as unfortunately happens in many other places.
If you want to spend a beautiful evening by the sea with a good atmosphere, delicious cocktails and music - the Sailing Club is definitely worth a visit.

While the salmon was tasty even at half the price this would be overpriced.
Hubby had seafood marinara, again it was very tasty but it would take 2-3 bowls to be a decent serving.

Poor service
Mar 2026 • Friends
There was a total of six of us went for international womens day. When we arrived we were seated in a nice courner. We ordered drinks but kept asking when they will be arriving first drink came and the others arrived 20mins later. The waitors did not know if they were coming or going. We then had to ask for the food menus in which had been removed. The first two meals arrived then 45mins later the other 6 arrived and it was getting late and we were all hungry. The food i had to say was delicious but the service very poor. Not the cheapest resturante and at those prices you expect better service. We ordered another drink in which again took a while to arrive. They did give us a complimentary fruit platter that was not much good i have had better from the beach sellers. Overall very disappointing. Not a place i would eat in again. Great setting right on the beach but very over rated.

Once glorious, now a shadow of its former self.
Feb 2026 • Couples
I've always been a fan of the Sailing Club since 2017. Visited last week and was lost for words at our poor experience. Chicken Caesar salad was at best OK but not the same excellence as previous visits. My wife's prawn curry and rice arrived a half hour later and was lukewarm with a stone cold naan bread, probably two days old. We could not attract waiter service to get drinks or even a dessert menu. Even the bill took 15 minutes to turn up and we missed our bus back to Movenpic. Really, really poor, we won't be going back. Sad loss, I used to love this place.
